positions.title: Senior SAP CPI Integration Consultant
positions.description:
Designed and implemented enterprise integrations using SAP CPI to connect SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and external systems across oil & gas business domains.
Built and optimized iFlows using Groovy scripting, Message Mapping, Content Modifiers, and XSLT for complex data transformations.
Developed real-time and batch integrations using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, and SFTP interfaces.
Implemented secure integration mechanisms using OAuth 2.0, SSL certificates, Basic Authentication, and SAP Cloud Connector.
Supported SAP landscape modernization initiatives including SAP S/4HANA migration and legacy interface decommissioning.
Monitored and troubleshot integration issues using SAP CPI Monitoring, Message Processing Logs, and Exception Subprocesses to ensure high availability.
Collaborated with functional and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable SAP BTP Integration Suite solutions.
Ensured compliance with SAP Clean Core principles, integration best practices, and enterprise security standards.
Performed performance tuning and error-handling enhancements to support high-volume transactional processing.
Created technical documentation and supported delivery using JIRA, Confluence, Postman, and Git.

positions.title: SAP CPI Integration Consultant
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and deployed SAP CPI integration flows (iFlows) to connect SAP S/4HANA, internal banking systems, third-party APIs, and external partner applications.
Implemented secure data exchanges using REST, SOAP, OData, IDoc, SFTP, and AS2 protocols to support payment processing, financial reporting, and customer account systems.
Configured and enhanced integration logic using Groovy scripting, Message Mapping, XSLT, Content Modifier, and Value Mapping components to meet complex enterprise requirements.
Ensured secure connectivity across on-premise and cloud environments using SAP Cloud Connector, OAuth 2.0, SSL certificates, SAML, and encrypted channels aligned with enterprise security policies.
Collaborated closely with functional teams (Finance, Risk, Compliance, Treasury) to translate business requirements into scalable SAP BTP Integration Suite solutions.
Monitored and troubleshot production and pre-production integration issues using SAP CPI Monitoring, Message Processing Logs, and custom alerts to maintain SLA compliance and operational performance.
Participated in large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation initiatives, including integration rationalization, enhancement of legacy interfaces, and consolidation of middleware artifacts.
Developed reusable integration templates and patterns to reduce cycle times and standardize integrations across business units such as payments, ledger posting, and data movement.
Provided ongoing support, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions for integration errors, performance bottlenecks, and message failures in collaboration with application support teams.
Documented technical designs, integration specifications, and operational runbooks, and coordinated delivery activities using JIRA, Confluence, Git, and Postman for testing.
